image_description: A dark blue and white minibus parked on a gravel surface. The vehicle features a boxy shape, a large front windshield, side windows, and visible text/branding on the side and front. A portion of another blue vehicle is visible in the bottom right foreground.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Boxy body shape noticeably shorter than a full-size bus, yet tall enough for passengers to stand or sit upright comfortably.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle exhibits the characteristic compact, high-roofed boxy silhouette of a minibus, distinct from full-size buses.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large front windshield is clearly visible, and multiple side windows are present along the passenger cabin.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Height is substantial, with entrance door at front or mid-body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle has significant height relative to its width. The driver's door is visible, and the sliding track for the passenger entrance is implied/visible on the side.
The panel gaps and handle configuration on the side indicate a sliding door mechanism typical of this class.
The short hood and grille arrangement at the front confirm the presence of an engine compartment.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rear flat or slightly angled panel with taillights and license plate mount.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rear of the vehicle is outside the frame; only the front three-quarters are visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: White, yellow, or company livery paint with route markings.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle has a two-tone blue and white livery with visible text/logos, fitting the description of company/route markings.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Standard van-sized wheels with steel or alloy rims.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible front wheel is proportional to the vehicle body and appears to be a standard steel rim with a hubcap.
The window configuration and overall size are consistent with a capacity of 4-10 passengers.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The white text on the side door ('go...') appears distorted and partially illegible, with letters merging into the background texture, a common AI artifact in rendering specific typography.
The plastic texture of the front bumper lacks fine detail and appears slightly 'smudged' or overly smooth compared to the metallic paint above it.
The blue object in the immediate foreground (likely another car) has undefined geometry and seems to merge nonsensically with the ground and the minibus's wheel well area.

selected_experts.reason: To verify the specific make/model consistency and ensure the vehicle is correctly classified as a minibus rather than a van or truck.
To rigorously analyze the garbled text on the side and front for legibility and structural coherence of characters.
To check for edge bleeding between the tire, the wheel arch, and the strange blue object in the foreground.
To assess global sharpness, lighting consistency, and detect any subtle generative noise or blur artifacts.

focus_areas: Legibility and structure of text on the vehicle side
Boundary definition between the front tire and the foreground blue object
Geometric consistency of the side mirror and door handles
Texture realism of the front grille and bumper
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the side of the bus. AI models often fail to render coherent words, resulting in 'alien script' or melted letters. Also, scrutinize the bottom-right corner where the blue foreground object interacts with the main subject; this area shows signs of spatial confusion. Ensure the wheel geometry is circular and not elliptical due to perspective errors.
